name: Synthavex
description: Synthavex is a daily maintenance compound for individuals with synthetic organ replacements — artificial hearts, lungs, kidneys, and livers that incorporate living SNT-hybrid tissue. It provides the specific enzymatic cofactors, lubricating proteins, and ionic balancers that synthetic organs require to maintain function, preventing the gradual mechanical degradation and SNT tissue death that occurs when these compounds are absent.
effects: prevents mechanical wear in hybrid organ components
sustains SNT tissue health within synthetic organs
regulates the immune interface around synthetic organs
prevents calcification of synthetic organ components
side_effects: altered urine and sweat odor due to excretion of metabolites
mild nausea in first weeks of use
interactions with some natural organ medications
long-term use causes dependency — synthetic organs deteriorate rapidly without it
street_price: Φ25 per day (generic); Φ85 per day (Novafold premium)
cultural_context: Anyone with a synthetic organ lives on Synthavex. It is life-critical in the most literal sense — miss a week and a synthetic kidney begins to fail; miss a month and it can become a source of sepsis. The cost disparity between generic and premium creates a constant low-grade anxiety for Tier 1-2 users. Nightshade Pharmatech produces a gray-market version that works but causes the distinctive metallic sweat smell that marks 'synth users' in the Gray Zone.
story_hooks: A the Gray Zone community's Synthavex supply has been cornered by a local boss who is charging extortion prices to people who will die without it
The Nightshade gray-market Synthavex contains a compound that slowly degrades SNT tissue in synthetic organs — the manufacturer knows

A character with a synthetic heart discovers their Synthavex prescription has been flagged — Lazarus will only refill it if they agree to participate in a data-sharing program about their organ's performance metrics
